translations.web: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
translations.bsb: And love consists in this: not that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
translations.kjv: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.
translations.asv: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.
